title: Nine Wings of August
subtitle: 环境保护 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 环境保护（环境保护·环境问题与保护）
meta: 主题语境：环境保护（环境保护·环境问题与保护）　|　核心词汇：butterfly　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 butterfly 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1960 my mother was sent to count ① a butterfly she could not catch, and she said the catching was the whole of the lesson. The ② butterfly, meaning the insect and not the season, was nine wings wide in the drawing and was recorded by whoever came last; a butterfly, she said, is the only thing in a meadow that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ butterfly in that meadow had the same marking, and the ④ butterfly at the edge, meaning the one the warden watched and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever counted properly. A butterfly, my grandmother said, is nine parts colour and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the colour is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ butterfly was the whole of the August, meaning the season it marked and not the insect. The ⑥ butterfly, meaning the season and not any of that, is the only thing in a field that everybody photographs and nobody questions; a butterfly, he said, is either something you count or the only word that means both an insect and a season. She said the season is the part they remember.

By 1976 the ⑦ butterfly had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the colour. The ⑧ butterfly of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine wings and eleven years of counting; a butterfly, she said, is either the one at the edge or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ butterfly I remember is the one at the edge, which was drawn in 1980 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ butterfly, my grandmother said in 1985, is the only thing that improves by being watched; every butterfly, she said, is a season that has agreed to look like an insect. She said the season was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 蝴蝶（指那只虫本身，与季节相对）
C. 固定搭配：count a butterfly 清点一只蝴蝶
D. n. 蝴蝶（指草地上每一只）
E. n. 蝴蝶（指边上那一只）
F. n. 蝴蝶（抽象：它所标记的那个季节）
G. n. 那个季节（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a butterfly she could not catch

answers.why: count a butterfly 意为“清点一只蝴蝶”，1960 年母亲被派去清点一只她捉不到的蝴蝶。
butterfly 意为“蝴蝶”，指那只虫本身而不是季节，画上宽九只翅膀，由最后走的人记录。
butterfly 指草地上每一只蝴蝶，每一只都是同样的斑纹。
butterfly 指边上那一只（看护员盯的那一只），是唯一有人认真清点过的。
butterfly 意为“蝴蝶”，抽象指它所标记的那个季节，父亲说 butterfly 就是那个八月的全部。
butterfly 为抽象用法，指那个季节本身，是田野里人人都拍照、却没人质疑的东西。
butterfly 意为“蝴蝶”，到 1976 年这只 butterfly 成了报告里的一张照片。
butterfly 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九只翅膀和十一年的清点。
butterfly 意为“蝴蝶”，我记得的是边上那一只，1980 年被画下来，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
butterfly 为抽象总称，祖母说蝴蝶是唯一会因为有人肯看它而变好的东西。
